scope: 13 source occurrences, 12 prior canonical lessons in 11 batches; no canonical, decision, manifest or release edits by reviewer.

decisionRows.sourceSentence: A reliable editor helps separate the signal from the noise.
Do not swallow everything whole after one report.
Young adults need time to stand steadily on their own two feet.
Dictionaries help children stand on their own feet academically.
Regular calls help with keeping relationships warm.
Art can be squeezed to the edges of a busy schedule.
The children need space to breathe and invent stories.
The two friends are on the same wavelength.
Good teachers open the academic door for new students.
An apology with no follow-through feels weak.
Names can slip through the cracks when we are distracted.
Taking the course means leaving the door open for a new role.
Digital booking is woven into ordinary life.

owners.assessment: Signal/noise wording is the same useful-evidence-versus-distraction decision.
Everything whole broadens the object, not the uncritical-acceptance sense.
Young-adult and academic independence are domain applications of standing on one’s own feet; the keyed dialogue preserves advice versus surrendered decision.
Regular calls keep personal ties warm; revised old-friends takeaway avoids shifting to merely professional contact.
Busy schedule substitutes for timetable while retaining peripheral time/priority.
Space to breathe is the same relief/freedom as room to breathe; keyed dialogue distinguishes manageable pacing from withdrawal.
Be on the same wavelength is the achieved mutual-understanding state of get on the same wavelength.
Academic door is access to study, within opportunity-opening scope.
No follow-through after apology is the absent action component of the existing promise-versus-action owner.
Names missed through distraction can be overlooked in a checking process; revised keyed dialogue keeps concrete assigned follow-up rather than a filed note alone.
Leaving one door open retains a particular option, the same future-choice metaphor as keeping more doors open.
Digital booking integrated into ordinary life is the same everyday-routine fabric metaphor.

assessmentKeyReview.advanced-native-419.dialogue: Key allows advice while preserving the learner’s final independent choice; distractors confuse advice with surrendering the choice or rejecting information. English/Chinese align.
assessmentKeyReview.advanced-native-307.dialogue: Key asks for breathing room to complete the project properly, not withdrawal; distractors misread realistic scheduling as low commitment. English/Chinese align.
assessmentKeyReview.advanced-native-534.dialogue: Key assigns contact before closing a referral so the family cannot slip through the cracks; distractors treat filed notes or duplicate referrals without responsibility as sufficient. English/Chinese align.
